name: io_submit
synopsis: int io_submit(aio_context_t ctx_id, long nr, struct iocb **iocbpp);
description: The io_submit system call queues asynchronous I/O requests in the specified AIO context. It submits an array of I/O control blocks for processing.

parameters.name: ctx_id
parameters.description: The AIO context ID to which requests are submitted.

parameters.name: nr
parameters.description: The number of I/O requests to submit.

parameters.name: iocbpp
parameters.description: An array of pointers to I/O control blocks containing the details of the I/O operations.

return_value.success: Returns the number of iocbs submitted (which may be less than nr, or 0 if nr is zero)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Insufficient resources are available to queue any iocbs.
The file descriptor specified in the first iocb is invalid.
One of the data structures points to invalid data.
The AIO context specified by ctx_id is invalid, nr is less than 0, or the iocb is not properly initialized.
io_submit() is not implemented on this architecture.
The aio_reqprio field is set with the class IOPRIO_CLASS_RT, but the submitting context does not have the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability.
